question_as_asked: What elements are in a double type bond?

question.question_text: What elements are in a double type bond?
question.evidence_text: double type bond refers to bond_type = '=';

executed_sql:
SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id IN (
    SELECT atom.atom_id
    FROM atom
    JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
    JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
    UNION
    SELECT atom.atom_id
    FROM atom
    JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
    JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
)
